name: Hallowed Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Branstock Khalder sends novice priests the Hallowed Rune to begin their training at Anvilmar.

sections.title: A Calling to the Light
sections.body: The Hallowed Rune bears teachings of the Holy Light. A young priest proves their resolve by aiding the valley’s mountaineers and defenders. Then Branstock sends them to Anvilmar, where he teaches them to mend wounds and wield holy power against the troggs threatening Dun Morogh.

faq.answer: The Hallowed Rune is a sacred stone inscribed with guidance for novice priests. Branstock Khalder sends it to call them to begin their spiritual and magical instruction inside Anvilmar.

faq.q: Who sends the Hallowed Rune to you?
faq.answer: Branstock Khalder, the dwarven priest trainer in Anvilmar, sends the Hallowed Rune to novice priests in Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: What should I do after receiving the Hallowed Rune?
aliases: where do i take the rune
what to do with hallowed rune
faq.answer: Read the rune, then go to Anvilmar’s main hall and present yourself to Branstock Khalder. He offers to teach you new prayers and spells.

faq.q: Why does Branstock want novice priests trained so quickly?
faq.answer: Branstock wants novice priests trained because troggs keep invading Coldridge Valley. The mountaineers need healing and holy power to defend Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a priest, you begin your formal mentorship under the Holy Light in Coldridge Valley with the Hallowed Rune.
As a dwarf, you bring reverence for the Light and duty to Ironforge together as you defend your mountain homeland from troggs.
